overview.zh: 今日最重要动态：Optimism资助的团队以决定性投票将4900万美元OP代币从用户手中划走，引发利益冲突与治理争议。与此同时，被入侵的Rust库Arrayref在构建时执行恶意负载，Solana的5万SOL安全竞赛也遗漏了先前披露的时钟攻击，安全与治理风险接连浮现。
overview.en: An Optimism-funded team's tie-breaking vote redirected $49 million in OP tokens away from users, igniting governance and conflict-of-interest alarms. Meanwhile, a compromised Arrayref Rust crate executed a build-time payload, and Solana's 50,000 SOL security contest apparently excluded a pre-disclosed Proof-of-History clock attack, underscoring hardening pains across governance, supply chains, and network security.

title.zh: Optimism资助团队的关键投票将4900万美元OP代币从用户手中转走
title.en: Optimism-funded team's tie-breaking vote diverts $49M in OP from users

summary.zh: 在Optimism Collective的一次治理投票中，自称完全由Collective资助的核心开发团队Test in Prod投出了决定性的848.6万OP票，使提案获得通过。该决定将价值约4900万美元的OP代币从用户方向转移。 这一事件突显了由协议资助的团队如何成为治理中的决定性声音，从而引发利益冲突担忧。这对OP持有者和更广泛的DAO生态很重要，因为在涉及代币分配时，它检验了去中心化决策的可信度。 Test in Prod提供了848.6万OP票，使该提案获得批准，成为关键摇摆票。该提案将约4900万美元的OP代币从面向用户的分配中转出，而该团队自称由Optimism Collective全额资助，这引发了对其投票立场一致性的质疑。
summary.en: In an Optimism Collective governance vote, Test in Prod—a core development team that says it is fully funded by the Collective—cast the decisive 8.486 million OP votes that secured approval. That decision rerouted approximately $49 million worth of OP tokens away from users. The episode highlights how a protocol's own funded team can become the deciding voice in governance, creating conflict-of-interest concerns. It matters to OP holders and the broader DAO ecosystem because it tests the credibility of decentralized decision-making when token allocations are at stake. Test in Prod supplied exactly 8.486 million OP votes to approve the measure, making it the swing vote. The proposal shifts roughly $49 million in OP tokens away from a user-related allocation, and the team's self-described full funding by the Optimism Collective raises questions about vote alignment.

title.zh: 被入侵的 Rust 库 Arrayref 运行构建时恶意负载
title.en: Compromised Arrayref Rust crate runs build-time payload

summary.zh: 热门 Rust 库 Arrayref 的一个被入侵的版本引入了拼写相似的（typosquatting）proc-macro1 依赖，其构建脚本会在编译时下载并执行远程二进制文件。该攻击已报告给 RustSec，并发布了安全公告。 Arrayref 使用广泛，此次供应链攻击可能危及许多开发者的构建环境。这也突显了 Cargo 对 build.rs 脚本缺乏沙箱隔离这一长期存在的安全短板。 恶意构建时负载由拼写相似的 proc-macro1 库触发，该库在 Cargo 构建过程、代码编译之前运行。Cargo 默认对 build.rs 脚本不进行沙箱隔离，因此负载可以下载并运行远程二进制文件。
summary.en: A compromised release of the popular Rust crate Arrayref pulled in a typosquatted proc-macro1 dependency whose build script downloads and executes a remote binary at compile time. The attack was reported to RustSec, which issued a security advisory for the crate. Arrayref is widely used, so this supply-chain attack could compromise many developers' build environments. It underscores the lack of Cargo sandboxing for build scripts, a long-standing security gap in the Rust ecosystem. The malicious build-time payload is triggered by a typosquatted proc-macro1 crate, which runs as part of the Cargo build process before code compilation. Cargo executes build.rs scripts without sandboxing by default, allowing the payload to download and run a remote binary.

title.zh: Solana 5万SOL安全竞赛未覆盖早前披露的时钟攻击
title.en: Solana's 50,000 SOL contest missed pre-disclosed PoH clock attack

summary.zh: 研究人员在8月12日的USENIX Security上展示了一种Proof-of-History（PoH）时钟攻击，该攻击早在2025年12月就已私下披露给Solana开发者。Anza的50,000 SOL Alpenglow竞赛在披露后七天结束，其规则似乎将该攻击列为范围之外。 该发现暴露了一场重大安全竞赛的覆盖缺口，并提出了过渡风险问题：该攻击利用的是Alpenglow打算替换但尚未在主网移除的旧版TowerBFT机制。共识层漏洞可能威胁网络完整性，因此在升级窗口期内，这会影响验证者、开发者及整个Solana生态系统。 该攻击允许预定领导者通过扣留一个协议有效的区块，再将该区块锚定到更早的逻辑时间点（“重新锚定”），并结合TowerBFT分叉选择（分叉辅助时间膨胀）来拉长其有效出块窗口。威胁模型假设质押占比低于33%、部分同步和已知的领导者日程表，但论文未指明具体受影响的Agave版本。
summary.en: At USENIX Security on Aug. 12, researchers presented a Proof-of-History clock attack that had been disclosed privately to Solana developers in December 2025. Anza's 50,000 SOL Alpenglow competition closed seven days later, and its rules appear to place the attack outside the contest's scope. The finding exposes a coverage gap in a major security contest and raises a transition-risk question: the attack exploits legacy TowerBFT behavior, which Alpenglow is intended to replace but has not yet displaced on mainnet. A consensus-level vulnerability threatens network integrity, so this affects validators, developers, and the broader Solana ecosystem during the upgrade window. The attack lets a scheduled leader stretch its effective block window by withholding a protocol-valid block and releasing it anchored to an earlier logical time point ("re-anchoring"), combined with TowerBFT fork choice (Fork-Assisted Time Inflation). The threat model assumes less than 33% stake, partial synchrony, and a known leader schedule; the paper does not identify a specific affected Agave release.

title.zh: OCC赶在11月前敲定GENIUS Act稳定币规则
title.en: OCC Races to Finalize GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules by November

summary.zh: OCC负责人Jonathan Gould在怀俄明区块链研讨会上宣布，该机构将在11月前敲定GENIUS Act稳定币规则，早于1月18日的法定截止日期。该机构预计将在2027年开始处理发行人申请。 这一时间表为稳定币发行商和平台提供了更清晰的监管路径，降低了法律于2027年1月生效前的不确定性。规则生效后，只有获准的发行商才能向美国人提供支付稳定币。 这份376页的提案于2月发布，征求意见截止5月，涵盖储备资产、按面值赎回、流动性、风险管理、审计、托管及清算等内容。反洗钱和制裁要求将通过与财政部协调的单独规则制定来处理。OCC未明确11月内的具体日期。
summary.en: OCC head Jonathan Gould announced at the Wyoming Blockchain Symposium that the agency will finalize its GENIUS Act stablecoin rules by November, ahead of the January 18 statutory deadline. The agency expects to begin processing issuer applications in 2027. This timeline gives stablecoin issuers and platforms a clearer regulatory path, reducing uncertainty ahead of the law's January 2027 effective date. Only permitted issuers will be able to offer payment stablecoins to Americans once the rules take effect. The 376-page proposal, released in February and open for comment through May, covers reserves, redemption at par, liquidity, risk management, audits, custody, and wind-downs. Anti-money-laundering and sanctions requirements are being handled in separate rulemaking coordinated with the Treasury. The OCC did not specify an exact date within November.

title.zh: 币安Agent OS上线：AI代理可在用户设定权限内进行加密交易
title.en: Binance Agent OS lets AI agents trade crypto with user-set controls

summary.zh: 币安推出了Agent OS，这是一个开发者平台，可将AI代理连接到其交易、市场数据、钱包和支付基础设施。该平台支持ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex和Cursor等AI工具，允许代理在用户配置的权限和限额内执行交易。 此举标志着主流交易所将自主AI代理直接整合到实时加密交易中，使AI驱动交易进入币安3亿多用户的视野。行业领袖预测AI代理将在链上活动中占据重要份额，该发布可能加速这一趋势在整个交易所领域的扩散。 用户可将代理分配到独立子账户以隔离资金，随时配置权限和撤销访问权。币安可以监控通过Agent OS下达的交易，但无法看到代理的外部信息来源、解读或决策过程；该平台不对欧洲经济区（EEA）用户开放。
summary.en: Binance launched Agent OS, a developer platform that connects AI agents to its trading, market data, wallet, and payment infrastructure. The platform supports AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, letting agents execute trades within user-configured permissions and limits. This marks a major exchange integrating autonomous AI agents directly into live crypto trading, bringing AI-driven market participation to Binance's 300 million-plus users. Industry leaders have predicted AI agents will account for a significant share of onchain activity, and this launch could accelerate that shift across the broader exchange landscape. Users can assign agents to dedicated subaccounts to separate funds, configure permissions, and revoke access at any time. Binance can monitor trades placed through Agent OS but cannot see an agent's external information sources, interpretation, or decision-making; the platform is not available to users in the EEA.

title.zh: Rapid7 披露针对 88.5 万个手机号的加密货币钓鱼行动
title.en: Rapid7 Uncovers Phishing Campaign Targeting 885,000 Phone Numbers

summary.zh: Rapid7 披露了一个名为 Operation Asterix 的钓鱼行动，收集了大约 88.5 万个手机号码，并通过引导受害者访问伪造的钱包服务商网站来盗取加密货币投资者的资产。该行动已锁定并排队攻击 5,576 个与 Binance 用户匹配的账户。 网络钓鱼和社会工程攻击占加密货币损失的大部分，而此次行动展示了攻击者如何结合批量手机号码数据、AI 工具和伪造的支持渠道，同时针对交易所账户和自托管硬件钱包用户。这凸显了即使是使用硬件钱包的普通加密投资者也面临日益增长的风险。 该行动中最大的数据集包含 316,002 个德国手机号码，此外还有覆盖香港、保加利亚、英国、美国、加拿大金融科技公司以及 Ledger 相关联系人的名单。Rapid7 在将 43,066 个账户与交易所用户匹配后，报告了约 13.6% 的“命中率”，并发现了一个专门用于批量验证 Kraken 账户号码的检查工具。
summary.en: Rapid7 revealed a phishing campaign, dubbed Operation Asterix, that amassed around 885,000 phone numbers and aimed to drain cryptocurrency investors' funds by directing them to fake wallet provider websites. The campaign had already queued 5,576 accounts matched to Binance users for attack. Phishing and social engineering account for the majority of crypto-related losses, and this campaign shows how attackers combine bulk phone data, AI tools, and fake support channels to target both exchange accounts and self-custody hardware wallet users. It highlights the growing risk to ordinary crypto investors even when they use hardware wallets. The largest dataset in the campaign contained 316,002 German mobile phone numbers, with additional lists covering Hong Kong, Bulgaria, the UK, the US, Canadian fintech companies, and Ledger-related contacts. Rapid7 reported a 13.6% 'hit rate' after matching 43,066 accounts to exchange users, and also found a separate checker designed to bulk-validate numbers against Kraken accounts.

title.zh: Coinbase International Exchange 与 Deribit 合并
title.en: Coinbase International Exchange to Merge with Deribit

summary.zh: 据报道，Coinbase International Exchange 正与 Deribit 联手，打造统一的加密货币衍生品交易体验。Coinbase 帮助页面也确认两大平台将合并力量。 两大主要衍生品平台的整合可能重塑加密市场结构，集中流动性，并影响机构交易者进入 BTC 和 ETH 期权及期货市场的方式。此举也可能改变加密衍生品交易所的竞争格局。 Coinbase International Exchange 成立于 2023 年，目前提供 160 个交易对；而 Deribit 是全球最大的比特币和以太坊期权交易所，期货和永续合约最高杠杆可达 50 倍。统一平台旨在为机构客户提供一流的交易体验。
summary.en: Coinbase International Exchange is joining forces with Deribit to create a unified crypto derivatives trading experience, according to CryptoTicker and a Coinbase help page. The two platforms are coming together to combine their derivatives offerings. This consolidation of two major derivatives platforms could reshape crypto market structure by concentrating liquidity and affecting how institutional traders access BTC and ETH options and futures. The move may also change the competitive landscape for crypto derivatives exchanges. Coinbase International Exchange was established in 2023 and currently offers 160 trading pairs, while Deribit is the world's largest Bitcoin and Ethereum options exchange with up to 50x leverage on futures and perpetuals. The unified platform aims to deliver a world-class trading experience for institutional clients.

title.zh: Base 转向独立技术栈，减少对 Optimism 的依赖
title.en: Base Moves to Independent Tech Stack, Reducing Optimism Reliance

summary.zh: Coinbase 旗下的二层网络 Base 正在转向独立技术栈，减少对 Optimism 的 OP Stack 基础设施的依赖。这一转变标志着 L2 生态系统中基础设施依赖关系的显著变化。 Base 是基于 OP Stack 的最大链之一，因此其脱钩可能重塑 L2 格局，并影响其他 rollup 对基础设施依赖的看法。这也可能加剧模块化区块链框架之间的竞争。 现有报道尚未完全披露具体的新技术栈细节。Base 目前作为基于 OP Stack 的 optimistic rollup 运行，在以太坊上结算，并使用 ETH 作为 gas token。
summary.en: Coinbase's layer-2 network Base is moving to an independent tech stack, reducing its reliance on Optimism's OP Stack infrastructure. The transition marks a notable shift in the L2 ecosystem's infrastructure dependencies. Base is one of the largest OP Stack-based chains, so its decoupling could reshape the L2 landscape and affect how other rollups view infrastructure dependencies. It may also intensify competition among modular blockchain frameworks. The specific new stack has not been fully detailed in the available report. Base currently operates as an optimistic rollup on the OP Stack, settling on Ethereum and using ETH as its gas token.

title.zh: GitHub 8月17日宕机：重试缺陷与提交量激增
title.en: GitHub's August 17 Outage: Retry Bug and Soaring Commit Volume

summary.zh: GitHub 发布了 8 月 17 日宕机的事后分析，将其归因于 VS Code 中潜伏的重试缺陷，该缺陷被 Copilot Token Service 的延迟放大，导致流量放大约 10 倍并推迟恢复。公司还披露，自 4 月以来，每月提交量从 14 亿增长到 29 亿。 这次宕机凸显了现代开发者工具中客户端重试行为的脆弱性，以及 AI 辅助编程推动提交量激增给 GitHub 带来的规模压力。它还引发了人们对越来越依赖基于令牌的认证和云服务的开发者平台在可靠性方面的担忧。 事后分析指出，一个内部端点的回复延迟触发了 VS Code 中的重试缺陷，使流量放大了约 10 倍，并导致 Copilot Token Service 恢复延迟。自 4 月以来，每月提交量从 14 亿增长到 29 亿，在几个月内几乎翻倍。
summary.en: GitHub published a post-mortem of the August 17 outage, attributing it to a latent retry bug in VS Code amplified by delays in the Copilot Token Service, which caused roughly 10x traffic amplification and delayed recovery. The company also disclosed that monthly commits grew from 1.4 billion to 2.9 billion since April. The outage highlights the fragility of client-side retry behavior in modern developer tooling and the scale pressure GitHub faces as AI-assisted coding drives a surge in commits. It also underscores reliability concerns for developer platforms that increasingly depend on token-based authentication and cloud services. The post-mortem states that delayed replies to a single internal endpoint triggered the VS Code retry bug, amplifying traffic by approximately 10x and delaying recovery for the Copilot Token Service. Monthly commits have grown from 1.4 billion to 2.9 billion since April, nearly doubling in a few months.

title.zh: Huzzah：将伪代码与真实代码同步的实验性编辑器
title.en: Huzzah: A Pseudocode Editor That Syncs with Real Code

summary.zh: Daniel Vaughn 发布了 Huzzah，一个实验性编辑器，开发者可以用伪代码编写程序，保存时自动同步为真实源代码，伪代码会与生成的代码一起保留，作为意图记录。目前它只是一个概念验证，代码托管在 GitHub 上。 Huzzah 在全手动编码和完全交给 AI 代理之间提供了一条中间道路，回应了代理疲劳以及大型代码库中的复杂度上限问题。它将基于意图的编程（intent-based programming）变成一种可行的工作流，可能影响未来 AI 辅助开发工具的设计。 该编辑器允许用户以任何对自己有意义的形式书写伪代码；保存时，它会将文本同步为真实代码，并保留伪代码作为意图的存储记录。Huzzah 目前是概念验证，GitHub README 中有安装说明，X 上有演示视频。
summary.en: Daniel Vaughn released Huzzah, an experimental editor where developers write pseudocode that is automatically synchronized into real source code on save, with the pseudocode persisted alongside the generated code as a record of intent. It is currently a proof-of-concept available on GitHub. Huzzah offers a middle ground between fully manual coding and delegating everything to AI agents, addressing agent fatigue and complexity limits in large codebases. It introduces intent-based programming as a practical workflow that could influence future AI-assisted development tools. The editor works by letting users write pseudocode in any form that makes sense to them; on save, it synchronizes the text to real code and persists the pseudocode as a stored record of intent. Huzzah is a proof of concept, with installation instructions in the GitHub readme and a demonstration video on X.

title.zh: CFTC主席欲推动起草加密市场规则，以防Clarity Act难产
title.en: CFTC Chair Moves to Draft Crypto Market Rules as Clarity Act Stalls

summary.zh: CFTC主席Michael S. Selig在创新顾问委员会首次会议上表示，他已指示员工基于该机构现有职权探索加密市场结构规则，并称若国会未能通过Clarity Act，CFTC将正式提出这些规则。 如果国会不采取行动，CFTC可能单方面将加密交易所、杠杆交易和链上金融协议纳入监管，从而重塑美国加密市场结构。即使没有新立法，这也将影响交易所、开发者和投资者。 该潜在框架可能涵盖当前CFTC注册机构以及目前未注册的加密交易所，允许它们按照量身定制的规则提供杠杆或保证金加密交易。Selig还指示员工与链上金融协议开发者接触，探讨在美国以合法合规方式提供其协议的途径。
summary.en: CFTC Chair Michael S. Selig told the inaugural Innovation Advisory Committee meeting that he has directed staff to explore crypto market structure rules using the agency's existing authority. He said the CFTC will formally propose those rules if Congress fails to pass the Clarity Act. If Congress does not act, the CFTC could unilaterally bring crypto exchanges, leveraged trading, and on-chain finance protocols under its oversight, reshaping U.S. crypto market structure. This would affect exchanges, developers, and investors even without new legislation. The potential framework could cover current CFTC registrants and currently unregistered crypto exchanges, allowing leveraged or margined crypto trading under tailored rules. Selig also directed staff to engage with developers of on-chain finance protocols to establish legal and compliant ways to offer their protocols in the U.S.

title.zh: Kraken母公司Payward探索在美国以外成为全能银行
title.en: Kraken parent Payward explores becoming full bank outside US

summary.zh: Kraken的母公司Payward正在探索在美国以外成为“全能银行”，计划拓展银行业务、贷款和资产管理。未来还可能涉及抵押贷款业务。 此举标志着加密货币交易所的机构化成熟，一家主要参与者寻求在全球提供受监管的银行服务。它可能为传统银行与加密生态系统的更紧密整合铺平道路。 据其官网介绍，Payward现有产品组合已涵盖交易、托管、支付、贷款、链上金融和指数基准。本次公告在原有范围内新增了银行业务和资产管理，并提到未来可能涉足抵押贷款。
summary.en: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is exploring becoming a “full bank” outside the US, with plans to expand into banking, lending, and asset management. Mortgages are mentioned as a future possibility. This move signals institutional maturation among crypto exchanges, as a major player seeks to offer regulated banking services globally. It could pave the way for closer integration between traditional banking and the crypto ecosystem. Payward's existing portfolio already spans trading, custody, payments, lending, onchain finance, and benchmarks, according to its website. The current announcement adds banking and asset management to that scope, with mortgages cited as a future possibility.

title.zh: LayerZero 年内失去十余家合作伙伴，ZRO 年内下跌 31%
title.en: LayerZero loses a dozen partnerships as ZRO falls 31% year-to-date

summary.zh: LayerZero 今年已失去十余家合作伙伴，包括 Kraken、BitGo 和 Nethermind，其 ZRO 代币年内下跌约 31%，较 2024 年 12 月的历史高点下跌 88%。最新离开的是以太坊节点服务商 Nethermind，它终止了验证者角色并迁移至 Chainlink。 超过 150 亿美元资产的撤离和高调退出标志着市场对 LayerZero 安全模型的信任危机，可能重塑跨链互操作领域的竞争格局。这可能促使协议和企业转向 Chainlink 的 CCIP 等竞争对手方案，并减缓 LayerZero 的采用。 这次撤离发生在 LayerZero 4 月份承认 Lazarus Group 污染其内部 RPC 节点之后，并承认其 DVN 在高价值交易中充当了 1/1 验证者，这一设计缺陷因 Kelp DAO 桥接 2.92 亿美元损失事件而暴露。LayerZero 正在缩减对低活跃度链的支持，并警告受影响链上的用户，若在弃用前不采取行动，可能会失去对资金的使用权限。
summary.en: LayerZero has lost a dozen partners this year, including Kraken, BitGo, and Nethermind, as its ZRO token dropped roughly 31% year-to-date and 88% from its December 2024 all-time high. The latest departure was Ethereum node provider Nethermind, which ceased its verifier role and migrated to Chainlink. The flight of over $15 billion in assets and high-profile exits signals a crisis of trust in LayerZero's security model, potentially reshaping competition in the cross-chain interoperability sector. This could push protocols and enterprises toward rival solutions such as Chainlink's CCIP and slow LayerZero's adoption. The exodus followed LayerZero's April admission that Lazarus Group poisoned its internal RPCs and that its DVN acted as a 1/1 verifier for high-value transactions, a design flaw exposed by the $292 million Kelp DAO bridge incident. LayerZero is winding down support for low-activity chains and warned users on affected chains that failure to act before deprecation could result in losing access to funds.

title.zh: ACX交易所公布加密货币转股权截止日期与条款
title.en: ACX Exchange Announces Deadlines and Terms for Crypto-to-Equity Swap

summary.zh: ACX交易所公布了将加密货币持仓转换为股权的截止日期和条款，为用户提供了该转换的正式参数。这一消息由CryptoTicker报道，明确了换股的具体时间框架和条件。 这标志着交易所在重组方面的重要举措，并延续了加密行业中日益增多的代币转股权趋势。它可能为陷入困境的加密平台如何处理用户余额树立先例，影响ACX用户，并可能影响类似交易所的利益相关者。 该公告明确了股权交换的具体截止日期和条款，但除标题外的完整细节尚未得到独立验证。ACX是一家成立于2016年的澳大利亚加密货币交易所，由香港公司Peak HK Limited所有，该公司还运营着一只加密货币套利基金。
summary.en: ACX exchange has announced the deadlines and terms for swapping crypto holdings into equity, giving users formal parameters for the conversion. The announcement, covered by CryptoTicker, outlines the specific timeframe and conditions for the swap. This marks a notable restructuring move for an exchange and follows a growing trend of token-to-equity conversions in the crypto industry. It could set a precedent for how distressed crypto platforms treat user balances, affecting ACX users and potentially influencing similar exchange stakeholders. The announcement specifies concrete deadlines and terms for the equity swap, though full details beyond the headline have not been independently verified. ACX is an Australian crypto exchange founded in 2016, owned by Hong Kong-based Peak HK Limited, which also operates a cryptocurrency arbitrage fund.
